text:
neha: Heads-up — CI alerted that pass@k jumped from 0.28 -> 0.41 for the quantized-rnntv2 model after landing the deduping change.
ci-bot: CI: eval-runner #427 failed on eng-ml/evals (pass@k threshold).
eli: wait that big? did the sample count change or is it a metric bug?
maria: looking at the runner logs now — sampling params were temp=0.9, top_p=0.95, n=100. Dedup window=50 was applied post-gen.
jake: if dedup is applied before computing pass@k (i.e. de-duplicating samples) then the denominator shrinks and pass@k inflates. we've seen this before with rerank/dedup interplay.
sophia: can you paste the pass@k impl? quick grep shows evals/metrics/passk.py: `successes = len({g for g in gens if is_correct(g)}); passk = successes / len(set(gens))` — uh huh that's the problem (using set(gens) there).
neha: ugh. the intent was to de-duplicate exact token-identical repeats for reporting, but pass@k should use raw samples (or de-dup only for final artifact).
eli: minimal repro: run runner with `--seed=42 --n=100 --dedup-window=50` and compute pass@k on raw list vs deduped list. I can push a tiny test to CI.
maria: also noticed dashboard rounding — the dashboard shows 0.41 but the raw job output prints 0.406 which led to threshold flip in CI. rounding + dedup combo = flaky alerts.
jake: propose two fixes: 1) metric change: compute pass@k on raw samples and only provide a deduped column for "unique samples"; 2) CI: compare against the raw value with epsilon, not the rounded dashboard value.
sophia: agree. Also we should make sampling deterministic in the runner unit test by stubbing RNG so we can assert exact counts.
neha: I'll open a PR with metric fix + unit test. quick patch: replace `len(set(gens))` with `len(gens)` and add a new `unique_passk` if we want that.
maria: optional extra: add a small doc note in eval-runner READMEs about "dedup post-processing" so future folks don't accidentally rely on deduped denominators.
ci-bot: CI: created issue #542 (eng-ml) "pass@k inflation from post-gen dedup" — linked to failing job.
eli: thanks. tagging @jake for dashboard rounding follow-up — we shouldn't gate CI on the rounded viz.
jake: will update the dashboard transform to show raw value as tooltip and change alert rule.
sophia: added unit test that runs sampling with a fixed RNG and asserts pass@k stable across quantization profiles (float16 vs int8) as long as model outputs are identical.
neha: PR up: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-ml/evals/pull/834 — contains metric change + test + small README note.
maria: reviewed, left one nit about doc wording.
neha: will merge after CI passes (should be fast now that we fixed the metric). :thumbsup:
eli: follow-up task: add an integration test that runs a small 10-sample job end-to-end on PRs that touch metrics or sampling logic. prevents this class of regression.
neha: added to sprint board. thanks all.
